title: Falling into step (Kuramoto)

data.source: Kuramoto model, 2000 oscillators, unit Gaussian natural paces, coupling 2.4, RK4, seeded

prediction: Each oscillator is a pushed rotor in the crowd's frame: those with natural pace below K r lock and stop cutting; the rest lap at pace sqrt(w squared minus (K r) squared), to within 3 %.
baseline: Kuramoto's 1975 analysis, which contains both statements and also gives the size of the crowd (r) and the coupling at which it first forms.
why: Both statements hold, and both are steps in the standard analysis. CRR describes one oscillator once the crowd is given; it does not say how big the crowd is or when it forms, which is the part the standard theory is known for.
